name: @jenix/smart-streamer-backend
description: Smart Streamer's VPS-side module — devices, cameras, destinations, schedules, sessions, diagnostics. Depends only on @jenix/shared and @jenix/device-schemas for types; every platform capability it needs (auth, device registry, Scenes) is passed in by api-server as a plain dependency object, never imported directly, so this package never reaches into api-server's own files.
